subject: Headcount swap request — performance-cycle promotion backfill
messages:
From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Headcount swap request — performance-cycle promotion backfill

Team,

Quick summary: I'm requesting an exception to the hiring freeze to backfill an individual contributor role (SWE II, infra) after proposing a promotion + lateral change for Priya N. into a manager role on my org. This is a swap: promote from within, which creates an IC vacancy we need to fill to keep roadmap commitments.

Why this matters now:
- Promotion accelerates a critical manager hire (Priya) who will own two active delivery streams and improve team throughput.
- If we don't refill the IC seat, several sprint objectives tied to infra reliability and rollout automation are at risk.

Tradeoffs and mitigations (short):
- Cost: net headcount stays the same for this fiscal quarter if we approve the swap; the promoted manager will have a comp uplift but we avoid hiring an additional FTE beyond plan. See attached hc-impact-analysis-q1.xlsx for numbers.
- Timing: recommended backfill as contractor-to-FTE ramp (45–60 days) to reduce near-term spend.
- Risk: roadmap slippage for release 1.3 if we defer backfill beyond Q2.

Request:
1) Approval to submit a hiring exception request (HCREQ-458) for the IC backfill against the promoted role.
2) Conditional go-ahead from Finance/People for contractor ramp while we finalize job posting.

Attachments: promotion-memo-markus-jan2026.pdf (promotion rationale + direct manager feedback), hc-impact-analysis-q1.xlsx (cost/timeline scenarios).

If useful, I can share a short MOS (mutual action plan) for the backfill timeline and interview panel this afternoon.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Headcount swap request — performance-cycle promotion backfill

Markus —

Thanks for the clear note and the attachments. Quick questions before I escalate to Finance:
- What's the expected comp uplift band for Priya? I want to confirm it doesn't push her outside our manager comp band assumptions (we can discuss off-thread).
- Can you confirm which deliverables would be deferred if we delay the refill 60+ days? Bullet list will help.

Assuming the numbers look reasonable, I'm inclined to approve the swap given the internal promotion benefit. Monica, can People confirm the hiring-exception precedent here? We should also mark this request as a high-priority backfill in the HC queue.

Laura Bennett
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: monica.patel@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Headcount swap request — performance-cycle promotion backfill

Thanks for the context. A few operational items from People & HR:

1) Hiring freeze policy: We can approve swaps that are headcount neutral and that support retention/promotions, but we need Exec sign-off for exceptions that require faster-than-normal onboarding (contractor ramp + convert) or any changes to banding that impact comp planning.

2) Required artifacts to move ahead:
- Completed HC Request form (see attached hc-request-form-458.pdf)
- Promotion memo signed by manager + skip-level (attached already)
- Comp recommendation and justification (ranges, target comp)
- Proposed interview panel and timeline

3) Timeline: if Markus submits the HC form today with comp rec, People can expedite review within 48 hours and route to Finance for sign-off. If Finance requires extra approvals, we'll flag the request in the HC queue.

I'll need the comp numbers and preferred start date for the backfill. Also tagging Hannah because she will help coordinate the role profile and interview panel.

Monica Patel
People Operations Partner
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: hc-request-form-458.pdf]

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Headcount swap request — performance-cycle promotion backfill

Markus / Laura / Monica —

I support the premise of promoting from within and backfilling when the swap is net headcount neutral. Two asks before I sign off formally:

1) Prioritization: please provide a one-page list (top 3 priorities) of what the backfilled IC will own in months 0–3. I want concrete milestones we can use for downstream SLA discussions.

2) Cost protection: recommend we initially route the hire as a 3-month contractor with a clear conversion bar (delivery + onboarding milestones). If People and Finance confirm comp cadence works, we'll convert to FTE — this reduces near-term cash burn risk.

If the one-pager and comp rec are shared by EOD tomorrow, I will sign the exception and ask Finance to expedite.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
